title: RS_FromPath
description: Creates an out-of-database raster from a raster file path.
kernels:
  - returns: raster
    args:
    - name: path
      type: string
---

## Description

Reads the header of the file at `path` and returns a raster whose bands
reference the source file as out-db bands. No pixels are read.

Each band becomes one whole-object chunk pointing at the file, decoded by the
`sedona.gdal` codec. The codec's configuration carries the 1-based source band
within the file, so every band of the raster shares one `RS_BandPath` and
differs only in its codecs. Pixels are read on demand (for example by
`RS_EnsureLoaded` or a function that needs them).

This is useful when you want to work with rasters stored on disk without copying
their pixel data into the raster value itself.

## Examples

```sql
SELECT RS_BandPath(RS_FromPath('../../../submodules/sedona-testing/data/raster/test4.tiff'));
```
